highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.3 retires built-in RAW and DNG decoding while preserving the public format enum.

breaking.title: Use a separate RAW or DNG decoder
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG development and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement decoder is included. Decode those containers with another library and pass supported pixels or images to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates decoding support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.
